_comment: Workspace-maintained codemogger root list + concept glossary. Single-root indexing is unsuitable because the workspace mixes the primary frontend (encv-mobile), a shared frontend package, a Go backend (internal), and managed sibling projects (combolite/openlist/preview-gateway) that must all be searchable. `weight` orders/labels multi-root FTS results (higher = more primary). Paths are relative to this file's directory (workspace root). codemogger only parses TS/Vue/Kotlin, so Go roots contribute via the full-repo grep complement, not FTS. `concepts` maps an architectural term to the precise tokens that actually locate it — this cuts substring noise (e.g. bare 'SPA' matches 'xcworkspace') by expanding to targeted terms.
